edges.reason: initialize compares msg.sender to the stored factory address, so only the factory may set the pair tokens
setFeeTo requires msg.sender == feeToSetter before writing feeTo
setMigrator requires msg.sender == feeToSetter before writing migrator
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender == feeToSetter before transferring authority
transferFrom spends the allowance granted to msg.sender
swap forwards msg.sender to the callee callback and the Swap event
permit compares the user-supplied deadline with block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
_update derives blockTimestamp from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value used for price accumulators
blockTimestampLast stores a value derived from block.timestamp
swap calls the untrusted ISoulSwapCallee.soulswapCall before validating the new balances and K invariant; state is transiently inconsistent
swap optimistically transfers output tokens before the balance checks
swap recomputes reserves and unchecked cumulative price accumulators via _update
amount0In is derived from balance minus (reserve0 - amount0Out) arithmetic
balance0Adjusted drives the K invariant multiplication, overflow-sensitive
_safeTransfer performs an arbitrary low-level call on a caller-influenced token address before state finalisation in callers
lock modifier serialises swap against cross-function reentrancy
lock modifier serialises mint
lock modifier serialises burn
lock modifier serialises skim
lock modifier serialises sync
lock modifier toggles the unlocked state variable around the guarded body
price0CumulativeLast is updated with an unchecked += intended to wrap
price1CumulativeLast is updated with an unchecked += intended to wrap
_update writes the reserve0 state variable
_update writes the reserve1 state variable
token0 is used to validate the recipient and compute inputs inside swap
token1 is used to validate the recipient and compute inputs inside swap
token0 is passed as the call target of _safeTransfer
createPair executes the inline-assembly CREATE2 deployment
the freshly deployed pair is immediately initialised, and initialize enforces a factory-only caller
createPair writes the getPair mapping in both directions and appends to allPairs
permit recovers the signer with ecrecover and requires it to equal owner
permit reads and increments nonces[owner] to prevent signature replay
permit binds DOMAIN_SEPARATOR into the signed digest
permit grants the approval by delegating to _approve
transferFrom delegates the actual balance move to _transfer
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping unless it is uint(-1)
_mintFee queries factory.feeTo() through the stored factory address, an external call
mint refreshes reserves and accumulators through _update
burn sends underlying tokens out via _safeTransfer after burning LP tokens
amount0Out parameter flows into the swap output transfer and callee call
amount1Out parameter flows into the swap output transfer and callee call
to parameter is the swap recipient and is validated against the token addresses
data parameter determines whether the flash-swap callback branch is taken
user-supplied data is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callee

owner parameter is used in the permit digest and as the approval owner
deadline parameter is a user-controlled timestamp bound checked against block.timestamp
recoveredAddress must be non-zero and equal owner for the permit to authorise
tokenA parameter is validated and used to derive the sorted pair and salt
tokenB parameter is validated and used to derive the sorted pair and salt
token parameter becomes the target of the low-level transfer call
